about: The two lineages of the frontier plan (docs/machine-learning/suphx-plan.md §9). A generation joins only through bench.js judge --promote. Models are pinned by git:<commit>:<path> once shipped, and by SHA-256.

lucky-cat.about: From lc32, the network that taught itself from random play; its own methods carried on. Releases lc33, lc34, ...

sphinx.about: From random weights, on features v2 and the structured network. Releases sphinx1, sphinx2, ... Its first generation is judged against random play.
